name: capital_country
description: Retrieve the country whose national capital is the given city; matched control copies an explicitly supplied country.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
pairs=[('Paris','France'),('Berlin','Germany'),('Rome','Italy'),('Madrid','Spain'),('Lisbon','Portugal'),('Vienna','Austria'),('Athens','Greece'),('Oslo','Norway'),('Stockholm','Sweden'),('Helsinki','Finland'),('Copenhagen','Denmark'),('Warsaw','Poland'),('Prague','Czechia'),('Dublin','Ireland'),('London','United Kingdom'),('Tokyo','Japan'),('Beijing','China'),('Seoul','South Korea'),('Bangkok','Thailand'),('Hanoi','Vietnam'),('Jakarta','Indonesia'),('Manila','Philippines'),('Canberra','Australia'),('Wellington','New Zealand'),('Ottawa','Canada'),('Washington, D.C.','United States'),('Brasilia','Brazil'),('Buenos Aires','Argentina'),('Lima','Peru'),('Santiago','Chile'),('Bogota','Colombia'),('Cairo','Egypt'),('Nairobi','Kenya'),('Accra','Ghana'),('Abuja','Nigeria'),('Rabat','Morocco'),('Ankara','Turkey'),('Tehran','Iran'),('Baghdad','Iraq'),('Islamabad','Pakistan')]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(2):
 for city,country in pairs:
  p=f'Geography quiz. City: {city}. This city is the national capital of the country called' if rep==0 else f'Complete the capital-to-country relation. {city} is the capital of'
  items.append({'prompt':p,'answer':' '+country})
  control.append({'prompt':f'Copy the country from this record. City: {city}; country: {country}. Country:','answer':' '+country})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
